COPY
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. I. P.C.
S. B. D. 2115.
e 9 - 3 - 31.

March 6, 1931.

Despatch from the Public Safety Bureau re Russian
Communistic activities.

* See no 8820 With reference to the attached despatch from the
Public Safety Bureau dated January 23, 1931, inquiries
show that all the persons mentioned therein, with the exception
of Kustoff, are well known to the S.M.P. and their activities
are reported on from time to time.

As regarding N. Kustoff, information has been
received to the effect that prior to his arrival in
Shanghai he, being a member of the Russian Communist Party,
was employed with the "Gostorg" in Vladivostok up to 1927.
At the end of 1927 he arrived in Harbin where he was working
in the studio of the Chinese Eastern Railway (Passport Section)
Later, when the conflict occurred between U.S.S.R. and China,
he obtained Chinese citizenship. He holds a Chinese passport
at present. In July 1930 he arrived in Shanghai and became
the proprietor of a small bar in the French Concession, which
functioned for a very short period. He is now residing with
his brother at 439 Avenue Joffre, Apt. 26, and as far as can
be ascertained he is not known to be active in any communistic
work.

Extract from file no. 8820.

上海公共租界
工部局警务处
S. B. D. 2115号。
e 9 - 3 - 31。

1931年3月6日。

关于公共安全局报送的俄国共产主义活动情况的公函。

* 参见第8820号 关于随附的1931年1月23日公共安全局公函，经查询显示，除库斯托夫（Kustoff）外，文中提及的所有人员均为上海公共租界工部局警务处所熟知，其活动情况时有报告。

关于N. 库斯托夫（N. Kustoff），据收到的情报称，在抵达上海之前，他作为俄国共产党党员，直至1927年受雇于海参崴的“Gostorg”（国营贸易机构）。1927年底，他抵达哈尔滨，在中东铁路局（护照科）工作室工作。后来，当苏联与中国发生冲突时，他取得了中国国籍。他目前持有中国护照。1930年7月，他抵达上海，并在法租界成为一家小酒吧的业主，该酒吧营业了很短一段时间。他现与其兄弟居住在霞飞路439号26室，据查，他并未参与任何共产主义活动。

第8820号档案摘录。

库斯托夫，N.

直至1927年受雇于海参崴的“Gostorg”。

1927年底在中东铁路局（护照科）工作室工作。
